seiten.Digitale Hegel-Texte gibt es seit langem: Digital Hegel texts have existed for a long time; they mostly follow older editions of the works, often in modernized spelling and without Hegel’s letter-spacing. This digital edition presents Hegel’s text according to the Gesammelte Werke (GW), the authoritative historical-critical edition: in the spelling of the GW, with letter-spaced type marked, citable line by line according to the GW pages. It contains only Hegel’s public-domain text, without the editors’ protected apparatus.
seiten.Die <em>Gesammelten Werke</em> (GW) sind: The Gesammelte Werke (GW) are the authoritative historical-critical edition (Hamburg: Felix Meiner, since {0}). Their printed pages contain marginalia, line numbering, footnote apparatus, and typographic conventions of the {1}th century.
seiten.Standard-OCR produziert aus diesen Vorla: Standard OCR turns these originals into mangled text — scrambled word order, illegible artifacts. The Digital Hegel Edition counters this with a multistage procedure that captures the text page by page and then checks it.
seiten.Hegels Text (gest. {0}) ist seit langem: Hegel’s text (d. {0}) has long been in the public domain. The historical-critical apparatus of the GW editors — introductions, footnotes, text-critical notes — remains protected by copyright (§§ {1} and {2} of the German Copyright Act, UrhG). This edition therefore publishes only Hegel’s own text, without the apparatus.
seiten.Erfasst wird der Text seitenweise, mit A: The text is captured page by page, with paragraphs, headings, emphasis, and original spelling. The result is a citable, searchable text with correspondences to the GW pages.
seiten.Sie ist keine eigene kritische Ausgabe u: It is not a critical edition of its own and does not replace the GW. The text-critical work is that of their editors; without their apparatus, variant readings, editorial reports, and notes are missing. Citations should follow the GW (Hamburg: Meiner, {0} ff.), and anyone working with the text for scholarly purposes should consult its volumes (more, Citing).
seiten.Die Ausgabe ist offen zug&auml;nglich un: The edition is open access and is being expanded continuously (open beta). The text is obtained by machine from the printed pages; the spelling, emphasis, and structure of the original are preserved.
seiten.Die Genauigkeit wird gemessen, nicht beh: Accuracy is measured, not claimed: about {0} % of words, checked on samples and thus on average above the threshold that the DFG Practical Guidelines on Digitization set for “practically error-free” text. Letter-spaced type is additionally measured geometrically — a script checks the letter spacing of every marked word in the scan.
seiten.Vollst&auml;ndige Fehlerfreiheit ist dam: Complete freedom from error is not guaranteed by this and cannot be proven, only narrowed down further. A complete review by humans has not taken place. Procedures, figures, and limits are set out in detail in the Guidelines.
